rule: No agent may promote a capability or claim production readiness while a CRITICAL remediation is OPEN, UNKNOWN, or UNVERIFIED.

remediations.title: Pin and enforce Python 3.12
remediations.acceptance: compile and test evidence under the declared Python 3.12 environment

remediations.title: Make parser failures fail closed
remediations.acceptance: negative test proves SyntaxError produces non-zero guardrail exit

remediations.title: Restore reproducible test execution
remediations.acceptance: pytest collection and required suites run under Python 3.12

remediations.title: Classify and close incomplete capabilities
remediations.acceptance: every TODO/NotImplemented on a reachable path has owner, state, evidence, and disposition

remediations.title: Resolve app and microservice source-of-truth drift
remediations.acceptance: contracts and boundary/parity tests identify one canonical source per sensitive concept

remediations.title: Prove runtime safety and rollback
remediations.acceptance: synthetic-data probes, failure tests, monitoring, secrets isolation, and rollback evidence

amendment_rule: Statuses may change only through a reviewed change with reproducible evidence; no agent may self-certify closure.
